# SmartX Solutions — Full Detail

> SmartX Solutions is a Hyderabad-based digital product agency. We build web apps, mobile apps, and digital experiences for ambitious businesses across India and globally.

---

## Company Overview

SmartX Solutions was founded to bridge the gap between great ideas and exceptional digital execution. We operate as a full-service agency — meaning a client can come to us with nothing but a vision and leave with a fully designed, developed, and deployed product.

We serve clients ranging from early-stage funded startups to established enterprises seeking digital transformation. Our team includes senior software engineers, UI/UX designers, cloud architects, and product strategists.

**Headquarters:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India
**Founded:** 2025
**Team size:** Growing
**Engagement model:** Project-based, retainer, or team augmentation

---

## Services — Full Detail

### 1. Web Application Development
Custom web applications built with modern frameworks. We specialise in:
- SaaS platform development
- Admin dashboards and internal tools
- Customer-facing portals and marketplaces
- Real-time applications (chat, notifications, live data)
- API development and third-party integrations
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, GraphQL

### 2. Mobile App Development
Native and cross-platform mobile applications:
- iOS and Android apps using Flutter (single codebase)
- React Native for JavaScript-first teams
- App Store and Google Play submission
- Push notifications, offline mode, biometric auth
- Integration with device features (camera, GPS, payments)

**Technologies:** Flutter, React Native, Dart, Swift (consultation), Kotlin (consultation)

### 3. UI/UX Design
Research-driven design that converts:
- User research and persona development
- Wireframing and information architecture
- High-fidelity UI design in Figma
- Interactive prototypes for stakeholder sign-off
- Design system creation (components, tokens, documentation)
- Usability testing and iteration
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1) compliance

**Tools:** Figma, FigJam, Maze, Hotjar

### 4. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
Scalable, reliable infrastructure:
- Cloud architecture design (AWS, GCP)
- CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
- Containerisation with Docker and Kubernetes
- Database setup, optimisation, and backups
- Auto-scaling and load balancing
- Monitoring and alerting (Datadog, CloudWatch)
- Security hardening and compliance

### 5. AI & Machine Learning Integration
Practical AI features for real products:
- LLM integration (OpenAI GPT-4, Claude, Gemini)
- AI chatbots and virtual assistants
- Recommendation engines
- Document processing and extraction
- Predictive analytics
- Computer vision features
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems

**Technologies:** Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, FastAPI

### 6. E-Commerce Development
Commerce platforms built to convert:
- Custom storefronts with headless architecture
- Shopify theme development and customisation
- Payment gateway integration (Razorpay, Stripe, PayU)
- Inventory and order management systems
- Multi-vendor marketplace platforms
- Subscription billing systems

### 7. Digital Transformation
Helping traditional businesses go digital:
- Legacy system analysis and modernisation roadmap
- Migration from monolith to microservices
- Process automation (workflows, notifications, reporting)
- ERP/CRM integration
- Staff training and technical documentation

### 8. Cybersecurity & Compliance
Security-first development:
- Security architecture review
- VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing)
- GDPR and data privacy implementation
- HIPAA-compliant architecture (for healthcare clients)
- Secure coding practices and code review

## Real Projects

### AG Traders — Live
A business website for AG Traders, a Palghar, Maharashtra-based manufacturer and supplier of fencing wire, chain link fencing, barbed wire, and galvanized iron products.
- **Built with:** Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Features:** Product catalogue, WhatsApp enquiry, SEO optimisation, mobile-first design
- **Status:** Live at https://agtraders.info
- **Industry:** Manufacturing

### Scholarship Management App — In Development
A web platform for students to discover and apply for scholarships, and for administrators to manage applications.
- **Built with:** React, Node.js, MongoDB, Firebase Auth
- **Features:** Student dashboard, application tracking, document upload, admin review workflow, status notifications
- **Status:** Active development
- **Industry:** EdTech / Education

### SmartX Solutions Website — Live
The agency's own website, designed and developed in-house.
- **Built with:** Next.js 15, TypeScript, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS
- **Features:** Cinematic preloader, particle canvas, word-reveal animations, custom cursor, full SEO suite, contact form
- **Status:** Live at https://smartxsolutions.in
- **Industry:** Agency / Marketing

## How We Work — Process

**Step 1: Discovery & Strategy (1–2 weeks)**
We learn about your business, users, and goals. Output: product roadmap, technical feasibility report, scope document.

**Step 2: Design & Prototype (2–4 weeks)**
UX wireframes → high-fidelity designs → clickable prototype validated with user feedback.

**Step 3: Agile Development (6–16 weeks)**
2-week sprints. Regular demos. Full transparency via shared project board and Slack channel.

**Step 4: Launch & Deploy (1–2 weeks)**
Zero-downtime deployment, performance testing, go-live coordination.

**Step 5: Growth & Support (ongoing)**
Monitoring, updates, bug fixes, and feature additions post-launch.

## Pricing

We work on a project basis with milestone-based payment:
- 40% upfront to commence
- 30% at midpoint milestone
- 30% on delivery

Budget ranges:
- Small websites / landing pages: ₹50,000 – ₹2,00,000
- Web applications (MVP): ₹2,00,000 – ₹8,00,000
- Full-scale platforms: ₹8,00,000+
- Mobile apps: ₹3,00,000 – ₹12,00,000+

All prices exclude GST. Free discovery consultation available.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How long does a typical project take?**
A: A simple website takes 3–6 weeks. A web application MVP typically takes 8–16 weeks. Mobile apps take 10–20 weeks depending on complexity.

**Q: Do you work with startups that don't have technical knowledge?**
A: Yes — many of our clients are non-technical founders. We guide you through every decision in plain language.

**Q: Who owns the code after the project?**
A: You do. Full IP ownership transfers to the client upon final payment. No lock-in.

**Q: Do you sign NDAs?**
A: Yes, always happy to sign an NDA before any sensitive discussions.

**Q: Can you work with an existing codebase?**
A: Yes. We regularly take over and improve existing projects.

**Q: Do you offer post-launch support?**
A: Yes. All projects include a 30-day bug-fix warranty. Ongoing support retainers are available.

**Q: What industries do you specialise in?**
A: FinTech, HealthTech, EdTech, E-Commerce, Manufacturing, Real Estate, and SaaS.

**Q: Are you open to international clients?**
A: Yes. We work with clients globally and are comfortable with remote collaboration across time zones.
